definitions.short: a sticky mass , i.e. the hump of a camel
definitions.full: H1707. dabbesheth [ דַּבֶּ֫שֶׁת ] 1. noun feminine hump (of camel) (etymology?) construct Isa 30:6 גְּמַלִּים עלדַּֿבֶּשֶׁת . 2. proper name, of a location on border of Zebulum Josh 19:11 דַּבָּ֑שֶׁת .
